mapper.insert:
insert into Statistics ( statistics_id, player_id, team_id, played_matches, goals, assists, penalties, season, league ) values
( #{statisticsDto.statisticsId}, #{statisticsDto.playerDto.playerId}, #{statisticsDto.teamDto.teamId}, #{statisticsDto.playedMatches}, #{statisticsDto.goals}, #{statisticsDto.assists}, #{statisticsDto.penalties}, #{statisticsDto.season}, #{statisticsDto.league} )
on DUPLICATE key update statistics_id = VALUES(statistics_id), player_id = VALUES(player_id), team_id = VALUES(team_id), played_matches = VALUES(played_matches), goals = VALUES(goals), assists = VALUES(assists), penalties = VALUES(penalties), season = VALUES(season), league = VALUES(league)
mapper.select: SELECT team_id AS teamId, name, league, logo, head_coach, stadium, location from team
